name: Public review reply desk
why: Runs each new batch of public reviews: a checked reply for each, risky ones held for the owner and repeat complaints flagged, as in the weekly review desk.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: Writes a specific public reply to each pasted review and lists the risky ones, matching the review reply desk skill.

name: Reply to reviews safely and plan how to get more
why: Combines themes, safe replies and an honest review ask plan in one run, a quick start for a new client.

name: Review reason spotter
why: Ranks why customers choose the business from 20 or more reviews, in their exact words, which feeds the praise side of the repeat complaint report.

name: Monthly customer voice keeper
why: Turns each month's new reviews into new buyer words and doubts for the brand file, alongside the monthly reputation review.

name: Monthly review proof keeper
why: Keeps approved review quotes checked and linked to evidence, and lists gaps for the next request, like the proof bank here.

name: Testimonial request writer
why: Writes a short testimonial request with three easy questions and a follow-up, the first step of the testimonial and consent library.

name: Turn a customer interview into a case outline
why: Turns one customer interview into a case study outline, an evidence gap list and what the customer must approve before publishing.

name: Turn reviews into a checked sales video and cut list
why: Builds a checked video script from product facts and reviews; use only quotes with permission on file.

name: Build a VIP program for your best customers
why: Finds the best customers and plans personal touches, a source of advocates who can be asked for testimonials and references.

name: Crisis response planner
why: Plans the first 30 days after a defect, complaint or failure, for when a review spike comes from a real incident.
